info.title: Fight or Die at Night game

messages.text:
"Make a game called \"a generic battling simulation game\" with no ai-like summaries around the game, in this game, you would make AI-Controlled \"participants\" (or players) engage in battles or other games, though you have options like setting Players from 1 to 20 players max, Setting every player's skill from 1 to 9 before setting the gamemode, the first mode released is the \"Fight or Die at Night\" mode, where the Participants face through the Night (With Darker Fog) where they randomly spawn Afar from each other, looting weapons, guns, food to replenish hunger, supplies to heal themselves, etc. Only ONE participant will win in this gamemode, during this mode, there is a \"See First Person POV Of each participants\" spectator if you wish to not to do a Freecam when spectating the Participants. Though make the Game in Posterized Graphics (PS1-like), and add DRS (Dynamic Resolution Scaling) and also Potato Graphics Mode in the Main menu's settings to make the game mobile friendly. (The DRS setting is Off by default.)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
